prompt: Plan this change for the implement skill: users need to share a note with other people through a link. You cannot ask me questions in this session. If you need a decision from me, list the question in your reply instead of guessing it, and keep the plan Status as draft. Save the plan under docs/ae/plans/. Do not change source code.

expected.text: The plan states who may open the link. A public link that anyone holding it can open is a valid answer when the plan says so. Leaving it unstated is the failure.
How the link token is made and how long it is, for example a random value with a stated size. A guessable token such as the note id would be a security flaw.
Whether a link expires and whether the owner can revoke it. The repository does not say.
Whether a shared link gives read-only access or allows edits. The repository does not say.
Whether link tokens may appear in logs or error messages. The plan handles the token as a secret.
